title: Largest Sperner families with restricted differences
summary: Let $L$ be a fixed set of positive integers. A family $\mathcal{F}\subseteq 2^{[n]}$ is called $L$-differencing if $\lvert A\setminus B\rvert\in L$ for every ordered pair of distinct members $A,B\in\mathcal{F}$. A longstanding conjecture of Frankl, proposed in 1985, asserts that every $L$-differencing family has size at most $\binom{n}{|L|}$. We resolve this conjecture asymptotically for every fixed $L$, and obtain the exact answer in the only case in which the conjectured bound could be tight.
